nodes.name: Get Preferences (Airtable)
nodes.notes: Reads a single row from a 'Config' table: Keywords, Locations, DatePosted, WorkType, EmploymentType, ExperienceLevel, MinSalary, ExcludedCompanies, JobTitleExclude, MaxItems, ResumeKeywords (JSON), MatchThreshold, BaseResumeText.

nodes.name: Build Apify Input
nodes.notes: Builds the input payload matching cheap_scraper/linkedin-job-scraper's schema: keyword[], locations[], publishedAt (r86400/r604800/r2592000), jobType[], workType[] ('on-site'/'remote'/'hybrid'), experienceLevel[], salaryBase, companyExclude[], jobTitleExclude[], resumeKeywords[], saveOnlyUniqueItems, enrichCompanyData, maxItems.

nodes.name: Run LinkedIn Jobs Scraper
nodes.notes: Leave the 'token' query parameter value empty and fill in your Apify API token. Actor: cheap_scraper/linkedin-job-scraper (id 2rJKkhh7vjpX7pvjg). Pay-per-result billing requires maxItems >= 150. run-sync-get-dataset-items blocks for up to 5 min and returns the scraped jobs directly.

nodes.name: Get Existing Job IDs
nodes.notes: Pulls only the 'Job ID' column from every row already in Airtable, used to deduplicate against newly scraped jobs.

nodes.name: Create Job Records
nodes.notes: Creates one row per new job with Status = New. Column names here must match your Airtable 'Jobs' table exactly (see README).

nodes.name: Process Job (Sub-workflow)
nodes.notes: Point 'workflowId' at the '2. Job Processor' workflow after you import it. This calls it once per new job: runs the LLM match/summary check, generates the tailored CV, and updates the Airtable row.
